standard.summary: 每个 micro-batch 的前后向 batch 大小。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The forward/backward batch size of each micro-batch.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 每个 micro-batch 的前后向 batch 大小。例如 batch=8 填 2，按 2+2+2+2 拆分

advanced_en.principle: Forward/backward batch size per micro-batch. E.g. with batch=8 fill in 2 to split as 2+2+2+2.
